supporting_observations.claim: At 13:49:14 UTC, WS-MSANTOS-01 sent 51,000,519 bytes to 10.54.20.30 on port 8080; the connection record reports 8,932 response bytes and an established connection state. This is consistent with the alerted large outbound transfer, though it is later than 13:46.
The recorded destination is the internal proxy address and port; this connection record does not identify the external destination or service.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available connection record contains byte counts and network endpoints, but no proxy request details, external destination, URL, or content.
The provided evidence does not attribute the large transfer to a process or identify the user or application that initiated it.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer went to an approved service such as OneDrive or to an unapproved destination.
Whether the bytes contained sensitive or otherwise unauthorized data.
Whether the transfer was initiated by Mia Santos or by an application running on the workstation.
Whether the proxy forwarded the data to an external destination or the full transfer completed beyond the connection to the proxy.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve PROXY-BLU-01 logs for the connection at 13:49:14 UTC, including the requested host, URL or CONNECT target, authenticated user, and transfer outcome.
Obtain endpoint process/network telemetry for WS-MSANTOS-01 around 13:46–13:50 UTC to identify the process responsible.
If available, collect file-access or upload metadata that could identify the transferred data and its source.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: FILE-BLU-01 made an RDP connection attempt to WS-MSANTOS-01 and attempted connections to its ports 80, 443, and 8080 around 13:54 UTC; the records do not establish the cause. These events are not the alerted 13:49 proxy transfer. (T189-00286, T189-00289, T189-00292, T189-00294, T189-00290, T189-00291, T189-00293, T189-00295, T189-00296)

Separate review: WS-MSANTOS-01 connected to FILE-BLU-01 over SMB at 14:11 UTC, and FILE-BLU-01 recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon. This is distinct from the alerted proxy transfer. (T189-00437, T189-00438, T189-00439, T189-00441)
